prompt: Employers are now able to record everything their staff do on company computers. Some people believe that employers should be free to do this. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the modern era, the technology is allowing the companies to see everything which the employees are doing on the office computers. Some people are saying that the employers should have the full freedom to do this monitoring. I do not fully agree with this, because the workers also have the right of privacy.

On the one hand, we can understand the employers. The computers and the internet connection are belonging to the company, and the company is paying the salary for the working hours. If some employees are wasting the time on the social media or on the shopping websites, the productivity is going down and the company is losing the money. Also, the monitoring can protect the important data, because sometimes the employees are stealing the information and selling it to the competitors.

On the other hand, too much monitoring is creating a bad atmosphere in the office. The employees are feeling that nobody is trusting them, and because of this the stress is increasing day by day. Moreover, sometimes people are using the office computer for the personal messages, for example to their family or to the doctor, and reading these messages is not fair for them. Everybody is needing some private space also, even in the office.

In conclusion, I think the employers can do some monitoring for the security reasons, but they should not read the personal messages of the employees, and they should tell the employees that the monitoring is happening. So the freedom should not be full.
title: Whether employers should monitor everything staff do
